page.description: Generate a routed page (*.page.ts) under src/app/pages, wrapping @schematics/angular:component with type=page.

model.description: Generate a model interface (*.model.ts) under src/app/shared/models.

mapper.description: Generate a mapper class (*.mapper.ts) under src/app/shared/mappers.

helper.description: Generate a helper class (*.helper.ts) under src/app/shared/helpers.

api.description: Generate an HTTP api class (*.api.ts) under src/app/shared/api.

service.description: Generate a plain (non-api) service class (*.service.ts) under src/app/shared/services.

store.description: Generate a signal store (*.store.ts) under src/app/shared/stores.
